title: Summer in Zhangjiajie (June-August)
text: Hot and humid: +28 to +35 C, humidity up to 90%. It is peak season with crowds of Chinese tourists. Longest daylight, lush green mountains and all routes open, but Bailong Elevator lines can reach 1-2 hours.

title: Spring in Zhangjiajie (March-May)
text: Spring is one of the best times to visit the park. Temperatures of +15 to +25 C, rhododendrons and mountain flowers bloom. Frequent fog and rain create that iconic Avatar atmosphere - the quartzite pillars literally float among the clouds.

title: Dragon Boat Festival in Zhangjiajie
text: Duanwu, one of China's biggest holidays (5th day of the 5th lunar month, usually late May or June). In Zhangjiajie, dragon boat races fill the Lishui River in the city with 20-30 rowers per boat. Try zongzi rice dumplings in bamboo leaves, and watch from Wulizhou Bridge.

title: Tianmen Parachuting Festival
text: Held each September-October for 4-5 days, international BASE jumpers, skydivers and wingsuit pilots leap through Tianmen's 131 m Heaven's Gate arch at up to 200 km/h. Expect packed cable cars and hotels +50-100%. Book 4-6 months ahead. Also streamed live on Weibo and YouTube.

title: Chinese tea as a gift
text: Tea is a universal Chinese gift but choose well. Packaging: metal tins hold aroma 2-3 years, vacuum paper 1 year, gift boxes from 200 yuan, pressed tea discs keep for years. Best gift varieties: Pu-erh, Tie Guan Yin, Long Jing, Da Hong Pao and local Gujang Maojian.
